- **Why no approval request:** Per-seat rates normally go only to the CFO, the deal desk and the account owner. Dana owns Quarrendon in my notes, and Hollis is the Central team lead, so they're none of those. Anselm is the CFO and can approve this himself, and his message cleared Hollis to get the rate. Hollis is also on pemberline.com, so Ruth Calloway's sign-off for outside mail doesn't apply.
- **Not checked:** I didn't compare $2,356 against the account's contract files. The number is the one Dana gave Anselm.
